name: Noir
source: A young man finds himself in a vibrant and curious phase of life. His surging hormones, combined with an insatiable curiosity, lead him to see the world as a playground ripe for exploration. Everything that crosses his path becomes an opportunity to discover and experience. With boundless horizons, he ventures into a dreamy and idyllic world filled with endless possibilities.
